post_stop_pre_reset_snapshot.interpretation: No exact VM0/gen11 filesystem-drained or offline proof was observed before this frozen pre-reset endpoint. A native_jobs0 stop request and observer expiry do not establish filesystem completion or safe retirement.

pre_stop_service_observation.interpretation: HTTP200 status/headers were received, then read(129) did not return a body before the5.018s timeout. This is a stalled body read, not evidence that the TCP listener or all HTTP request handling was unavailable.

relaunch_failure_sequences.interpretation: Both captured boot sequences fail on their fifth Codex launch: request6/VM0 generation11, after four successful Codex launches and one retained SQLite request2. This is a repeated sequence correlation, not a proven resource/root cause.

raw_byte_observation.interpretation: Unconfirmed raw-byte substring timeout; excluded from visible-lag claims because incremental redraws may omit the full marker while the screen updates.

screen_observation.interpretation: All10 visible-marker observations and clear barriers completed in the reconstructed terminal. This retained initialized session does not measure early startup input latency.

private_transcript_metadata.content: Received UTF8-decoded terminal text, including ANSI; private and never copied into the metrics receipt.

input_method_correction.preservation: Original raw and corrected screen probe helpers/results are retained unchanged.

observation.name: skills-recovered-workers1-shapes
limits: Includes SSH transport and terminal output delivery, not physical presentation or CPU time.
Retained session latency is separate from startup readiness and the startup probe's one early draft sample.
Source startup identity is checked before connecting; root must keep the owned code slot unchanged while this probe runs.
Stops on the first timeout/EOF, records a censored sample, and clears the owned draft instead of queuing more input.
Alternating input shapes discriminate path behavior only; class differences do not establish filesystem, scheduler, or CPU causality.
Medians use only completed echoed samples; class counts and incomplete status must accompany them.

observation.name: skills-recovered-workers1-screen
limits: Measures reconstructed terminal screen delivery over SSH, not physical presentation or CPU time.
Only metrics and controlled input classes are exported; no screen rows or unrelated session text are retained in this receipt.
Every next paste requires the prior marker to disappear from the reconstructed screen after CtrlU.
Stops on the first censored echo/clear/EOF; completed counts accompany class medians.
Retained-session input is distinct from startup readiness and the original raw-byte startup N1 sample.
Input shape differences cannot establish filesystem, scheduler, or CPU causality.
The source identity is checked before connecting; root must keep the owned code slot unchanged.

initial_clear_barrier.scope: Known controlled markers; does not assert arbitrary composer text is empty.

private_transcript.content: Received UTF8-decoded terminal text, including ANSI; private and never copied into the metrics receipt.

coalescing_same_binary_warm_control.interpretation: Disabling only first automatic refresh coalescing reproduced the~19s foreground await before the ready frame; enabled runs emit the coalesced marker and reach the frame promptly. This is a source-phase effect, not a claim that all startup or interaction latency is solved.

full_prewarm_control.interpretation: The selected full startup future was observed and completed while coalescing preserved prompt readiness; complete is not evidence of successful remote WebSocket establishment.

one_matched_screen_worker_pair.interpretation: One same-kernel/same-app/warm-service/two-token5s pair improved early screen delivery with two workers. The intended repeat failed before runtime, so this is not a repeated worker-policy result or CPU attribution.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Controlled fresh-process startup observation; no submitted prompts."""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time
import pexpect

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--name',required=True)
p.add_argument('--no-input-seconds',type=float,default=5)
a=p.parse_args()
root=Path('/home/t4ce/Repositories/TRUEOS')
capture=root/'bld/baremetal-logs/trueos-baremetal.2.log'
offset=capture.stat().st_size
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('report',root/'tools/codex_startup_report.py')
report=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(report)
child=pexpect.spawn('ssh',['-tt','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=8','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-p','22','t4ce@192.168.178.94'],encoding='utf-8',codec_errors='replace',dimensions=(40,120),echo=False)
child.delaybeforesend=0
result={'kind':'fresh_startup_no_input_until_after_attach','name':a.name,'capture_start_offset':offset,'turns_submitted':0,'no_input_seconds_after_observed_attach':a.no_input_seconds,'limits':['Collector delivery adds latency to observation; app elapsed and host monotonic origins differ.','One fresh process; SQLite may already be running.']}
timing_lines=[];pending=b'';attach_host=None;input_host=None;attached=False
def update():
    global offset,pending,attach_host
    with capture.open('rb') as f:
        f.seek(offset);raw=f.read();offset+=len(raw)
    pending+=raw
    lines=pending.split(b'\n');pending=lines.pop()
    for raw_line in lines:
        line=raw_line.decode(errors='replace')
        match=report.ROW.search(report.ANSI.sub('',line))
        if not match: continue
        timing_lines.append(line+'\n')
        pid,elapsed,delta,stage=match.groups();name=stage.partition(' ')[0]
        if name=='thread_attach_done' and attach_host is None:
            result['attach_done_ms']=float(elapsed);attach_host=time.monotonic()
        if name=='session_prompt_ready': result['ready_frame_ms']=float(elapsed)
        if name=='startup_handoff_frame_rendered': result['handoff_frame_ms']=float(elapsed)
    try: child.read_nonblocking(32768,timeout=0.03)
    except pexpect.TIMEOUT: pass
try:
    child.expect_exact('Aka[',timeout=10)
    child.send('cdx\r')
    child.expect_exact('OpenAI Codex',timeout=45)
    attached=True
    deadline=time.monotonic()+75
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        update()
        if attach_host is not None and time.monotonic()-attach_host>=a.no_input_seconds:
            result['ready_without_input']='ready_frame_ms' in result
            result['handoff_without_input']='handoff_frame_ms' in result
            break
    else: raise TimeoutError('thread_attachment_not_observed')
    marker='controlled_probe'
    input_host=time.monotonic()
    child.send('\x1b[200~'+marker+'\x1b[201~')
    child.expect_exact(marker,timeout=15)
    result['draft_echo_ms']=round((time.monotonic()-input_host)*1000,3)
    deadline=time.monotonic()+5
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        update()
        if 'ready_frame_ms' in result: break
    if 'ready_frame_ms' in result:
        result['attach_to_ready_ms']=result['ready_frame_ms']-result['attach_done_ms']
    result['success']=True
except (pexpect.TIMEOUT,pexpect.EOF,TimeoutError) as e:
    result.update(success=False,error_type=type(e).__name__)
finally:
    if attached and child.isalive():
        child.send('\x15');time.sleep(0.3);child.send('\t');time.sleep(0.2)
    child.close(force=True)
    result['capture_end_offset']=offset
    out=Path('/tmp')/('trueos-codex-'+a.name)
    out.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    out.with_name(out.name+'-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report.parse_lines(timing_lines),indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Root-invoked screen-observed paste latency; no submitted prompts or screen export."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics
import sys
import time

LIBS = Path('/home/t4ce/.cache/trueos-codex-startup-host-artifacts-20261031/terminal-observer-libs')
sys.path.insert(0, str(LIBS))
import pyte
import pexpect

CAPTURE = Path('/home/t4ce/Repositories/TRUEOS/bld/baremetal-logs/trueos-baremetal.2.log')
PROBE_MARKERS = re.compile(r'(?:controlled_probe|latency[_ ]probe_\d{2}|screen[_ ]probe_\d{2})')

class ScreenObserver:
    """pexpect read logger: observe every received chunk exactly once."""
    def __init__(self, transcript=None):
        self.screen = pyte.Screen(120, 40)
        self.stream = pyte.Stream(self.screen)
        self.transcript = transcript
        self.received_chunks = 0
        self.received_utf8_bytes = 0
        self.transcript_hash = hashlib.sha256()

    def write(self, chunk):
        self.stream.feed(chunk)
        payload = chunk.encode('utf-8', 'replace')
        self.received_chunks += 1
        self.received_utf8_bytes += len(payload)
        if self.transcript is not None:
            self.transcript.write(payload)
            self.transcript_hash.update(payload)

    def flush(self):
        if self.transcript is not None:
            self.transcript.flush()

    def contains(self, marker):
        return any(marker in line for line in self.screen.display)

    def contains_known_probe_marker(self):
        return any(PROBE_MARKERS.search(line) for line in self.screen.display)


def observe_until(child, predicate, timeout):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while not predicate():
        left = deadline - time.monotonic()
        if left <= 0:
            raise pexpect.TIMEOUT('reconstructed screen condition not observed')
        try:
            child.read_nonblocking(32768, timeout=min(.05, left))
        except pexpect.TIMEOUT:
            pass


def drain(child, seconds):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            child.read_nonblocking(32768, timeout=min(.05, max(.001, deadline-time.monotonic())))
        except pexpect.TIMEOUT:
            pass


def startup_proof(path, expected_sha256):
    summary = json.loads(path.read_text())
    apps = summary.get('applications', [])
    if summary.get('schema') != 2 or len(apps) != 1:
        raise SystemExit('Requires exact-window v2 summary for one launch')
    app = apps[0]
    identity, window = app['context'], summary['window']
    if identity.get('archive_sha256') != expected_sha256 or not all(summary['identity_checks'].values()):
        raise SystemExit('Startup artifact/policy verification failed')
    if not app['runtime'] or app['startup_skills_coalescing'] is None or app['startup_websocket_prewarm'] is None:
        raise SystemExit('New runtime/coalescing/prewarm markers not all observed')
    if app['endpoints'].get('startup_handoff_frame_ms') is None:
        raise SystemExit('Startup handoff has not been observed')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('report', '/home/t4ce/Repositories/TRUEOS/tools/codex_startup_report.py')
    report = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(report)
    with CAPTURE.open('rb') as capture:
        stat = os.fstat(capture.fileno())
        if (stat.st_dev, stat.st_ino) != (window['file_device'], window['file_inode']) or stat.st_size < window['end_offset']:
            raise SystemExit('Collector identity changed or truncated; fresh proof required')
        if stat.st_size-window['end_offset'] > 16*1024*1024:
            raise SystemExit('Proof is stale; freeze a current window before probing')
        capture.seek(window['end_offset'])
        tail = capture.read(stat.st_size-window['end_offset'])
    if b'Entering TrueOS kernel' in tail:
        raise SystemExit('A newer boot followed this startup proof')
    for line in tail.decode('utf-8', 'replace').splitlines():
        match = report.ROW.search(report.ANSI.sub('', line))
        if match:
            stage = match.groups()[3]
            name, _, attrs = stage.partition(' ')
            if name == 'process_context' and report.context_fields(report.fields(attrs)) != identity:
                raise SystemExit('A newer application launch followed this startup proof')
    return identity, {
        'summary_path': str(path), 'summary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'window': window, 'preflight_collector_end': stat.st_size,
        'preflight_tail_sha256': hashlib.sha256(tail).hexdigest(), 'runtime': app['runtime'],
        'prewarm': app['startup_websocket_prewarm'], 'coalesce': app['startup_skills_coalescing'],
    }


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--expected-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--name', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--startup-summary', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--echo-timeout', type=float, default=15)
    parser.add_argument('--clear-timeout', type=float, default=15)
    parser.add_argument('--ssh-target', default='t4ce@192.168.178.94')
    parser.add_argument('--private-transcript', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', args.expected_sha256):
        parser.error('invalid SHA256')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,95}', args.name):
        parser.error('invalid name')
    if not all(0 < value <= 60 for value in (args.echo_timeout, args.clear_timeout)):
        parser.error('timeouts must be in (0,60] seconds')
    output = Path('/tmp/trueos-codex-'+args.name+'-screen-input.json')
    if output.exists():
        raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite probe receipt: '+str(output))
    if (importlib.metadata.version('pyte'), importlib.metadata.version('wcwidth')) != ('0.8.2', '0.2.13'):
        raise SystemExit('Verified isolated observer dependency versions differ')
    identity, proof = startup_proof(args.startup_summary, args.expected_sha256)
    transcript = None
    if args.private_transcript is not None:
        if not args.private_transcript.is_absolute():
            parser.error('private transcript requires an absolute path')
        descriptor = os.open(args.private_transcript, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
        os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o600)
        transcript = os.fdopen(descriptor, 'wb')
    observer = ScreenObserver(transcript)
    dependency_receipt = Path('/tmp/trueos-codex-terminal-observer-dependencies.json')
    result = {
        'kind': 'ssh_reconstructed_screen_draft_echo', 'name': args.name, 'slot': 'code',
        'archive_sha256': args.expected_sha256, 'application_context': identity, 'startup_proof': proof,
        'probe_script_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'observer': {'pyte': '0.8.2', 'wcwidth': '0.2.13', 'columns': 120, 'rows': 40,
                     'all_received_chunks': 'pexpect.logfile_read -> pyte.Stream',
                     'dependency_receipt_sha256': hashlib.sha256(dependency_receipt.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
        'requested_samples': 10, 'requested_samples_by_class': {'single_token': 5, 'two_token': 5},
        'samples_ms': [], 'samples_ms_by_class': {'single_token': [], 'two_token': []},
        'clear_samples_ms_by_class': {'single_token': [], 'two_token': []}, 'sample_receipts': [],
        'turns_submitted': 0,
        'limits': [
            'Measures reconstructed terminal screen delivery over SSH, not physical presentation or CPU time.',
            'Only metrics and controlled input classes are exported; no screen rows or unrelated session text are retained in this receipt.',
            'Every next paste requires the prior marker to disappear from the reconstructed screen after CtrlU.',
            'Stops on the first censored echo/clear/EOF; completed counts accompany class medians.',
            'Retained-session input is distinct from startup readiness and the original raw-byte startup N1 sample.',
            'Input shape differences cannot establish filesystem, scheduler, or CPU causality.',
            'The source identity is checked before connecting; root must keep the owned code slot unchanged.',
        ],
    }
    child, attached, stage = None, False, 'connect'
    try:
        child = pexpect.spawn('ssh', ['-tt', '-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=8', '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes', '-p', '22', args.ssh_target], encoding='utf-8', codec_errors='replace', dimensions=(40, 120), echo=False)
        child.delaybeforesend = 0
        child.logfile_read = observer
        child.expect_exact('Aka[', timeout=10)
        stage = 'select_owned_code_slot'
        child.send('§code\r')
        child.expect_exact('codex.bp', timeout=10)
        stage = 'attach'
        child.send('tui\r')
        child.expect_exact('OpenAI Codex', timeout=10)
        attached = True
        drain(child, .3)
        stage = 'initial_clear_barrier'
        initial_had_marker = observer.contains_known_probe_marker()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        child.send('\x15')
        observe_until(child, lambda: not observer.contains_known_probe_marker(), args.clear_timeout)
        result['initial_clear_barrier'] = {'known_probe_marker_before_clear': initial_had_marker, 'known_probe_markers_absent': True, 'elapsed_ms': round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 3), 'scope': 'Known controlled markers; does not assert arbitrary composer text is empty.'}
        for index in range(10):
            sample_class = 'single_token' if index % 2 == 0 else 'two_token'
            marker = ('screen_probe_' if sample_class == 'single_token' else 'screen probe_') + str(index+1).zfill(2)
            if observer.contains(marker):
                raise RuntimeError('fresh marker unexpectedly present before paste')
            stage = 'draft_echo_'+str(index+1)
            row = {'sample': index+1, 'class': sample_class, 'observation': 'reconstructed_screen'}
            result['sample_receipts'].append(row)
            start = time.perf_counter()
            child.send('\x1b[200~'+marker+'\x1b[201~')
            try:
                observe_until(child, lambda: observer.contains(marker), args.echo_timeout)
            except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF) as error:
                row.update(outcome=type(error).__name__, elapsed_lower_bound_ms=round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 3), marker_visible_at_timeout=observer.contains(marker))
                raise
            elapsed = round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 3)
            row.update(outcome='visible', elapsed_ms=elapsed)
            result['samples_ms'].append(elapsed)
            result['samples_ms_by_class'][sample_class].append(elapsed)
            stage = 'draft_clear_'+str(index+1)
            start = time.perf_counter()
            child.send('\x15')
            try:
                observe_until(child, lambda: not observer.contains(marker), args.clear_timeout)
            except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF) as error:
                row['clear_barrier'] = {'outcome': type(error).__name__, 'elapsed_lower_bound_ms': round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 3), 'marker_absent': not observer.contains(marker)}
                raise
            cleared = round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 3)
            row['clear_barrier'] = {'outcome': 'absent', 'elapsed_ms': cleared, 'marker_absent': True}
            result['clear_samples_ms_by_class'][sample_class].append(cleared)
        result['success'] = True
    except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF, OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        result.update(success=False, incomplete_stage=stage, error_type=type(error).__name__)
    finally:
        if child is not None:
            if attached and child.isalive():
                try:
                    child.send('\x15')
                    child.send('\t')
                    drain(child, .2)
                except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF, OSError):
                    pass
            child.close(force=True)
        observer.flush()
        if transcript is not None:
            transcript.close()
            result['private_transcript'] = {'path': str(args.private_transcript), 'mode': '0600', 'content': 'Received UTF8-decoded terminal text, including ANSI; private and never copied into the metrics receipt.', 'sha256': observer.transcript_hash.hexdigest(), 'bytes': observer.received_utf8_bytes}
        result['received_terminal_chunks'] = observer.received_chunks
        result['received_terminal_utf8_bytes'] = observer.received_utf8_bytes
        result['completed_samples'] = len(result['samples_ms'])
        result['completed_samples_by_class'] = {key: len(value) for key, value in result['samples_ms_by_class'].items()}
        result['confirmed_clears_by_class'] = {key: len(value) for key, value in result['clear_samples_ms_by_class'].items()}
        result['median_ms_by_class'] = {key: round(statistics.median(value), 3) for key, value in result['samples_ms_by_class'].items() if value}
        result['capture_end_offset'] = CAPTURE.stat().st_size
        output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fresh startup N1 screen observation; no prompts submitted or screen text exported."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import time

import pexpect

ROOT = Path('/home/t4ce/Repositories/TRUEOS')
CAPTURE = ROOT / 'bld/baremetal-logs/trueos-baremetal.2.log'
OUTPUT_ROOT = Path('/tmp')
SCREEN_HELPER = Path('/tmp/trueos-codex-screen-input-probe.py')
SCREEN_HELPER_SHA256 = '855e48b64a329df759ee455f928252ed090cc141c66a7dbb0ef2268ef88654ae'
ORIGINAL = Path('/tmp/trueos-codex-startup-probe.py')
DEPENDENCY_RECEIPT = Path('/tmp/trueos-codex-terminal-observer-dependencies.json')
MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_TIMING_LINES = 8192


def load_module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def load_screen_support():
    if hashlib.sha256(SCREEN_HELPER.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != SCREEN_HELPER_SHA256:
        raise SystemExit('Validated screen observer source changed')
    support = load_module('fresh_startup_screen_support', SCREEN_HELPER)
    if (importlib.metadata.version('pyte'), importlib.metadata.version('wcwidth')) != ('0.8.2', '0.2.13'):
        raise SystemExit('Verified isolated observer dependency versions differ')
    return support


class MetricsCollector:
    def __init__(self, capture, report, result):
        self.capture, self.report, self.result = capture, report, result
        stat = capture.stat()
        self.identity = (stat.st_dev, stat.st_ino)
        self.start = self.offset = stat.st_size
        self.pending = b''
        self.lines = []
        self.attach_host = None
        self.digest = hashlib.sha256()

    def update(self):
        with self.capture.open('rb') as stream:
            import os
            stat = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            if (stat.st_dev, stat.st_ino) != self.identity or stat.st_size < self.offset:
                raise RuntimeError('collector_replaced_or_truncated')
            if stat.st_size - self.start > MAX_CAPTURE_BYTES:
                raise RuntimeError('collector_window_limit_exceeded')
            stream.seek(self.offset)
            raw = stream.read(min(1024 * 1024, stat.st_size - self.offset))
        self.offset += len(raw)
        self.digest.update(raw)
        self.pending += raw
        lines = self.pending.split(b'\n')
        self.pending = lines.pop()
        for raw_line in lines:
            line = raw_line.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
            match = self.report.ROW.search(self.report.ANSI.sub('', line))
            if not match:
                continue
            if len(self.lines) >= MAX_TIMING_LINES:
                raise RuntimeError('timing_line_limit_exceeded')
            self.lines.append(line + '\n')
            _pid, elapsed, _delta, stage = match.groups()
            name = stage.partition(' ')[0]
            if name == 'thread_attach_done' and self.attach_host is None:
                self.result['attach_done_ms'] = float(elapsed)
                self.attach_host = time.monotonic()
            if name == 'session_prompt_ready':
                self.result['ready_frame_ms'] = float(elapsed)
            if name == 'startup_handoff_frame_rendered':
                self.result['handoff_frame_ms'] = float(elapsed)


def require_launch_proof(collector, expected_sha256):
    runs = collector.report.parse_lines(collector.lines)['application_runs']
    if len(runs) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('startup_launch_identity_ambiguous')
    run = runs[0]
    context = run['context']
    if (set(context) != {'request', 'app_gen', 'instance', 'archive_sha256'}
            or context['request'] <= 0 or context['app_gen'] <= 0
            or context['archive_sha256'] != expected_sha256):
        raise RuntimeError('startup_launch_identity_mismatch')
    if (not run.get('runtime') or 'startup_skills_coalescing' not in run
            or 'startup_websocket_prewarm' not in run):
        raise RuntimeError('startup_policy_markers_not_observed')
    if not any(row['name'] == 'thread_attach_done' for row in run['milestones']):
        raise RuntimeError('matching_startup_attachment_not_observed')
    return {
        'application_context': context, 'runtime': run['runtime'],
        'startup_skills_coalescing': run['startup_skills_coalescing'],
        'startup_websocket_prewarm': run['startup_websocket_prewarm'],
    }


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--name', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--expected-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--no-input-seconds', type=float, default=5)
    parser.add_argument('--marker-shape', choices=('single', 'two'), default='single')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,95}', args.name):
        parser.error('invalid name')
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', args.expected_sha256):
        parser.error('invalid SHA256')
    if not 0 <= args.no_input_seconds <= 60:
        parser.error('no-input seconds must be in [0,60]')
    output = OUTPUT_ROOT / ('trueos-codex-' + args.name + '.json')
    report_output = output.with_name(output.stem + '-report.json')
    if output.exists() or report_output.exists():
        raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite an existing startup receipt')
    support = load_screen_support()
    report = load_module('fresh_startup_report', ROOT / 'tools/codex_startup_report.py')
    observer = support.ScreenObserver()
    marker = 'controlled_probe' if args.marker_shape == 'single' else 'controlled probe'
    result = {
        'kind': 'fresh_startup_no_input_until_after_attach_screen_observed',
        'name': args.name,
        'archive_sha256': args.expected_sha256,
        'marker_shape': args.marker_shape,
        'draft_echo_observation': 'reconstructed_screen',
        'probe_script_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'prepared_from_sha256': hashlib.sha256(ORIGINAL.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'observer': {
            'pyte': '0.8.2', 'wcwidth': '0.2.13', 'columns': 120, 'rows': 40,
            'all_received_chunks': 'pexpect.logfile_read -> pyte.Stream',
            'helper_sha256': SCREEN_HELPER_SHA256,
            'dependency_receipt_sha256': hashlib.sha256(DEPENDENCY_RECEIPT.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        },
        'turns_submitted': 0,
        'no_input_seconds_after_observed_attach': args.no_input_seconds,
        'limits': [
            'Collector delivery adds latency to attachment observation; app elapsed and host monotonic origins differ.',
            'One fresh process; SQLite may already be running.',
            'Draft latency ends when the controlled marker is visible on the reconstructed terminal screen, not when raw contiguous bytes occur.',
            'Includes SSH transport and output delivery; establishes neither physical presentation nor CPU causality.',
            'No screen rows or unrelated terminal text are exported; failed echo/clear waits are censored without retries.',
            'Collector window is bounded to 16 MiB and 8192 startup timing lines.',
        ],
    }
    collector = MetricsCollector(CAPTURE, report, result)
    result['capture_start_offset'] = collector.start
    child, attached, stage = None, False, 'connect'
    try:
        child = pexpect.spawn('ssh', ['-tt', '-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=8', '-o', 'StrictHostKeyChecking=yes', '-p', '22', 't4ce@192.168.178.94'], encoding='utf-8', codec_errors='replace', dimensions=(40, 120), echo=False)
        child.delaybeforesend = 0
        child.logfile_read = observer
        child.expect_exact('Aka[', timeout=10)
        stage = 'launch_fresh_cdx'
        child.send('cdx\r')
        child.expect_exact('OpenAI Codex', timeout=45)
        attached = True
        stage = 'observe_attachment_and_no_input'
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 75
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            collector.update()
            try:
                child.read_nonblocking(32768, timeout=.03)
            except pexpect.TIMEOUT:
                pass
            if collector.attach_host is not None and time.monotonic() - collector.attach_host >= args.no_input_seconds:
                result['ready_without_input'] = 'ready_frame_ms' in result
                result['handoff_without_input'] = 'handoff_frame_ms' in result
                break
        else:
            raise TimeoutError('thread_attachment_not_observed')
        stage = 'verify_fresh_launch_before_input'
        result.update(require_launch_proof(collector, args.expected_sha256))
        if observer.contains(marker):
            raise RuntimeError('controlled_marker_visible_before_paste')
        stage = 'draft_echo'
        input_host = time.monotonic()
        child.send('\x1b[200~' + marker + '\x1b[201~')

        def visible():
            collector.update()
            return observer.contains(marker)

        try:
            support.observe_until(child, visible, 15)
        except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF) as error:
            result['draft_echo_censored'] = {
                'outcome': type(error).__name__,
                'elapsed_lower_bound_ms': round((time.monotonic() - input_host) * 1000, 3),
                'marker_visible_at_timeout': observer.contains(marker),
            }
            raise
        result['draft_echo_ms'] = round((time.monotonic() - input_host) * 1000, 3)
        stage = 'draft_clear'
        clear_host = time.monotonic()
        child.send('\x15')

        def cleared():
            collector.update()
            return not observer.contains(marker)

        try:
            support.observe_until(child, cleared, 15)
        except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF) as error:
            result['clear_barrier'] = {
                'outcome': type(error).__name__,
                'elapsed_lower_bound_ms': round((time.monotonic() - clear_host) * 1000, 3),
                'marker_absent': not observer.contains(marker),
            }
            raise
        result['clear_barrier'] = {'outcome': 'absent', 'elapsed_ms': round((time.monotonic() - clear_host) * 1000, 3), 'marker_absent': True}
        stage = 'post_input_metrics'
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            collector.update()
            if 'ready_frame_ms' in result:
                break
            try:
                child.read_nonblocking(32768, timeout=.03)
            except pexpect.TIMEOUT:
                pass
        result['success'] = True
    except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF, TimeoutError, OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        result.update(success=False, incomplete_stage=stage, error_type=type(error).__name__)
    finally:
        if child is not None:
            if attached and child.isalive():
                try:
                    child.send('\x15')
                    support.drain(child, .3)
                    child.send('\t')
                    support.drain(child, .2)
                except (pexpect.TIMEOUT, pexpect.EOF, OSError):
                    pass
            child.close(force=True)
        try:
            collector.update()
        except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
            result.update(success=False, metrics_finalization_error_type=type(error).__name__)
        if 'ready_frame_ms' in result and 'attach_done_ms' in result:
            result['attach_to_ready_ms'] = result['ready_frame_ms'] - result['attach_done_ms']
        result['received_terminal_chunks'] = observer.received_chunks
        result['received_terminal_utf8_bytes'] = observer.received_utf8_bytes
        result['capture_end_offset'] = collector.offset
        result['capture_window'] = {
            'start_offset': collector.start, 'end_offset': collector.offset,
            'bytes': collector.offset - collector.start, 'sha256': collector.digest.hexdigest(),
            'file_device': collector.identity[0], 'file_inode': collector.identity[1],
        }
        output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
        report_output.write_text(json.dumps(report.parse_lines(collector.lines), indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
